offering_description.value: Provides broadband, video, voice and managed services over fiber and cable networks through TDS Telecom, to residential and business customers in mostly smaller US markets. Also holds a majority stake in a wireless carrier offering mobile service, devices and tower leasing.

primary_products.value: fiber broadband internet; video TV service; voice lines; smartphones and wireless devices

primary_services.value: broadband internet access; wireless voice and data service; managed IT and hosting services; tower site leasing; wholesale network access

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential broadband, TV, phone and wireless subscribers; B2B: small and mid-sized businesses, wholesale carriers, tower tenants; B2G: government agencies, public safety users and schools

end_markets.value: telecommunications; residential broadband; enterprise connectivity; rural and small-market communications

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly broadband, video, voice and wireless service plans; product sales: wireless handsets and accessories; service fees: managed services, wholesale access and network fees; rental or leasing: tower space leased to wireless carriers
revenue_model.category: subscription; product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates fiber, cable and wireless networks and towers, serving consumers, businesses and carriers; service provider: sells connectivity and managed services to end users

geography_served.value: US national: Wireline in about 30 states, wireless across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: wireline broadband/video/voice and wireless service, sharing network and customer base

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: business sales teams and call centers; own locations: company retail stores; online: website and online ordering; agents / brokers: authorized agents and third-party retailers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; online; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC licenses and spectrum, state public utility commissions, universal service programs

notes: Wireless business (UScellular) was largely sold to T-Mobile and others in 2025; remaining scope is uncertain.
